title: Convert the Primitive Type to Wrapper Class Object

blocks.content: Convert the Primitive Type to Wrapper Class Object
Create a program to convert the primitive type into their corresponding wrapper class object.

items: Create a char variable named x and assign 'c' to it.
Convert x to Character by assigning x to xObj of Character type.
